desc: Williamstown School No.1183, a primary school in the Melbourne suburb of Williamstown, Victoria, Australia, opened in 1873. The current bluestone building was used for exterior filming of the school for the children and teens of fictional Port Niranda in the television series Round the Twist (1990-2
